Verifying only the game files may not remove add-ons on the Steam client side. Check unfamiliar configurations with their source/provider. Only after confirming that an item is an add-on, save a record of the original setup and how to restore it, check the provider's safe disabling instructions, and compare after normally exiting and restarting Steam.

data.name: WildsCore.004
data.value: Do not delete or rename files based only on names. Do not modify DLLs in Windows System32/SysWOW64. Improvement after multiple changes does not establish that a single DLL was the cause. This tool does not close or move Steam, or change its settings.

data.name: WildsCore.006
data.value: If there are power losses, restarts, blue screens, or unusual heat, do not test by relaunching the game. Save your work and describe the symptoms to the PC manufacturer or a repair service.

data.name: WildsCore.007
data.value: Kernel-Power 41 alone does not establish a power supply or CPU fault. Do not run stress tests or change BIOS or voltage settings.

data.name: WildsCore.008

data.name: WildsCore.009

data.name: WildsCore.010
data.value: Do not add exclusions, allow blocked items, or disable protection. If there is a related detection, contact the software provider. Do not publish history that contains personal information.

data.name: WildsCore.011

data.name: WildsCore.012
data.value: In Steam → Library, right-click Wilds → Manage → Browse local files. Open MonsterHunterWilds.exe Properties → Compatibility and note the original values. If compatibility mode is enabled, the official guidance is to uncheck only that box and compare a launch from Steam. If nothing changes, check Steam.exe the same way.

data.name: WildsCore.013
data.value: This tool does not change settings or enable running as administrator. If the checkbox is disabled or managed, do not force a change; seek support. To revert, restore the original values you noted.

data.name: WildsCore.014

data.name: WildsCore.015
data.value: Open the main game executable's Properties → Compatibility and check the current state of “Run this program as an administrator.” Note its original value. Only if it can be changed with normal permissions, you can uncheck just this box and compare one launch from Steam. If nothing changes, record that you tried it and move on.

data.name: WildsCore.016
data.value: Registered values or the Mode field in an earlier CrashReport cannot establish the current checkbox state, effective privileges, or cause. The tool does not automatically change settings or elevate to administrator. Do not change organization-managed settings or settings for all users.

data.name: WildsCore.018

data.name: WildsCore.019

If nothing changes, that weakens the hypothesis that this tool alone caused the current issue; restore the original setup and move to the next check.

data.name: WildsCore.022
